items.docs:
This endpoint will list available <<glossary:assignment>>s for a <<glossary:loan officer>>.

Assigning a loan officer to another resource, provides them access to that resource's loans and the ability to interact with those loans.

> 🙇 Heads up!
**Assignments are restricted by the loan officer’s placement within the organization and possible setting configuration.**
